title: Grid Filling
statement: The task is to fill an n x m grid (n, m up to 1000, sums up to 1000) that full-length cuts split into rectangles, so each x-cell rectangle holds 1..x exactly once and side-adjacent cells differ, or report -1. It is impossible exactly when a height-1 strip exists and two width-1 strips are separated only by width-2 strips (or rows and columns swapped); otherwise a column-block construction works.
